notes: Volumetric (Sieverts) H2 uptake at 77 K on five steam-activated carbon hollow fibers (WC-ACHF-0% to 3.0%); BET areas about 1590-1902 m2/g in the Fig. 3 inset (only 1902 m2/g stated in text). Inconsistencies for extraction: Conclusion 2 says 4.51 wt% 'at 298 K and 100 bar', while the abstract, results text and Fig. 4 caption give 77 K and 100 bar; the Fig. 4b pressure axis is labelled only to 80 bar and the plotted points end near 85 bar although the text and caption say 100 bar; Fig. 4a y-axis runs to negative values. Uptake basis not named. CO2 uptake at 273 K also reported. No retraction or prior-publication statement found.
